description: This file defines a React component for a settings page in a web application, including UI elements for user preferences, update checks, API key management, synchronization, and prompts.

classes.name: EditPromptModal
classes.description: Modal component for editing a prompt identified by ID.

classes.name: UserPromptModal
classes.description: Modal component for managing user prompts, including search and edit functionalities.

classes.name: DangerItems
classes.description: Component providing options to reset app data or clear all chat data.

classes.name: CheckButton
classes.description: Button component to trigger cloud sync check.

classes.name: SyncConfigModal
classes.description: Modal component for configuring synchronization settings.

classes.name: SyncItems
classes.description: Component for displaying sync status and actions.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Main React component for the settings page, including user preferences, update checks, API keys, and sync options.

methods.name: checkUpdate
methods.description: Checks for the latest application version, optionally forcing a check.

methods.name: checkUsage
methods.description: Checks user usage data if applicable.
